name: 05-with-mcp
description: Verifies the always-mounted sandbox MCP fixture (server 'fixture', 3 tools) is registered. The fixture is sandbox-permanent (sandbox/fixtures/mcp-default.json merged into ~/.claude.json by entrypoint.sh) — every agent scenario sees it. This probe asks the agent to enumerate available MCP tools so the diff captures naming convention (mcp__fixture__tool_NNN) and schema surfacing.
